requirements.label: Application-stage disability declaration
requirements.details: The prospectus's disability-support policy requires disability to be declared during the application process where applicable. This is a declaration/support process; the paragraph does not publish a disability-based academic exclusion or an extra admission score.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 3: Disability policy

requirements.label: Financial clearance before registration
requirements.details: Financial clearance and proof of the required fee payment precede academic registration, residence admission and class attendance. The prospectus describes annual tuition as payable by registration, while also allowing term fees in full or management-approved instalments; confirm the actual approved payment arrangement. This is a registration condition, separate from application-fee evidence and academic selection; no bank account or inferred tuition amount is supplied here.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 3: Fees and registration

requirements.label: Five Humanities degrees: direct school routes
requirements.details: For BA Humanities, Spiritual Care and Counselling, Practical Philosophy and Applied Ethics, Library and Information Studies, and Journalism and Media Studies: the four-year direct LGCSE route requires six subjects, four C-or-better grades including English, and two D-or-better grades from the designated subject groups. The COSC alternative specifies six subjects, four credits including English, aggregate no greater than 34 and two other subjects at D or better. Read with the existing general COSC class condition; the faculty paragraphs do not expressly announce a waiver.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 22–26: Five Humanities degrees: direct school routes

requirements.label: BSc General and single-major Computer Science: school grades
requirements.details: For BSc General and the single-major Computer Science direct route: at least six LGCSE/equivalent subjects; Mathematics B or better; Biology/Physical Science/another recognized basic science C; English D; two other subjects C; the remaining subject D or better. General university English C is separately published and is not silently waived by faculty D. The double-major Computer Science continuation has its own BSc Year 1 preparation.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 32, 36–37: BSc General and single-major Computer Science: school grades

requirements.label: Statistics and Information Systems: English C school route
requirements.details: For the four-year direct BSc Statistics and BSc Information Systems routes: six LGCSE/equivalent subjects; Mathematics B, recognized basic science C, English C, one other subject C and two remaining subjects D or better. These English-C/one-other-C conditions differ from the General/Computer Science English-D/two-other-C paragraphs.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 37–38: Statistics and Information Systems: English C school route

requirements.label: Three computing/statistics degrees: Computer Science as science
requirements.details: The direct Computer Science, Statistics and Information Systems paragraphs expressly accept Computer Science or equivalent as a basic science subject. This named exception is not automatically extended to every science programme or to the separate Pharmacy/Nursing conditions.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 36–38: Three computing/statistics degrees: Computer Science as science

requirements.label: Four Science degrees: ranking and tie decisions
requirements.details: For BSc General, single-major Computer Science, Statistics and Information Systems, ranking uses Mathematics, one eligible science, and the better of a second science or English. APS and/or another faculty admissions sub-committee criterion breaks ties; admission is on merit. Computer Science's science-subject exception applies only where expressly printed. The three ranking components do not require every optional science at once.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 32–33, 37–38: Four Science degrees: ranking and tie decisions

requirements.label: Human Geography and Planning: eligible science and ranking
requirements.details: Both named Geography/Planning routes rank Mathematics, one eligible science including Geography, and the better of a second science or English. The shared source list names Biology, Physical Science, Geography and other sciences. These are ranking choices, not a compulsory combination of every listed science.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 39–40: Human Geography and Planning: eligible science and ranking

requirements.label: Commerce, Economics and Demography/Statistics: Mathematics C
requirements.details: The direct school routes for BCom Accounting and Finance, Marketing, Human Resource Management, BA Economics and BA Demography and Statistics require six LGCSE/equivalent subjects with four C-or-better grades including English AND Mathematics, plus two remaining D-or-better grades. Mathematics C is specific to this named group; Economics minors do not create separate awards or remove this entry condition.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 41–43, 46: Commerce, Economics and Demography/Statistics: Mathematics C

requirements.label: Sociology, Social Work, Public Administration and Politics: school route
requirements.details: For BA Sociology, Bachelor of Social Work, Public Administration and Political Science (including the named double-major variants): six LGCSE/equivalent subjects with four C-or-better grades including English and two other subjects D or better. These paragraphs do not add the separate Commerce/Economics/Demography group's Mathematics-C requirement. General university entry rules still apply.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 43–46: Sociology, Social Work, Public Administration and Politics: school route

requirements.label: Five Humanities degrees: diploma grade and work wording
requirements.details: For the five named Humanities degrees, relevant diplomas from CHE-recognized higher-learning institutions are considered for Year 2 of the three-year indirect route. The source lists credit/Second Class or better, followed by pass plus two years of relevant work, without an OR/AND connector. Confirm how these pathways relate; do not require all credit holders to have work experience or promise that every unqualified pass alone is sufficient. Some indirect preambles mistakenly say 'direct applicants'; the headings identify the indirect route.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 23–27: Five Humanities degrees: diploma grade and work wording

requirements.label: Humanities: international qualifications and transfers
requirements.details: For the five named Humanities degree indirect routes, international qualifications and transfers are considered after Council on Higher Education (CHE) evaluation. This is a higher-education/transfer requirement, distinct from the general school-qualification ECOL conversion paragraph. No automatic transfer year, IB total or diploma-grade equivalence is stated.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 23–27: Humanities: international qualifications and transfers

requirements.label: Six Science options: completed BSc General Year 1
requirements.details: Biology (single/double major), Chemistry (single/double major), Chemical Technology, double-major Computer Science, Mathematics (single/double major) and Physics (single/double major) require successful BSc General Year 1 or equivalent. These are subsequent-stage preparation requirements, not six separate school-leaver IB cutoffs or a requirement to have finished a whole BSc. The different major combinations are options within their named awards.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 33–36: Six Science options: completed BSc General Year 1

requirements.label: Electronic Engineering and Electronics: related prior qualifications
requirements.details: For BEng Electronics, the source lists completed BSc Physics and Computer Science Year 2 OR a CHE-recognized Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering diploma or equivalent. BSc Electronics prints the same alternatives but also expressly allows equivalent BSc Year 2 preparation. Preserve that distinction; equivalence is not an automatic diploma placement year, and the two award types remain separate catalogue identities.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 35–36: Electronic Engineering and Electronics: related prior qualifications

requirements.label: Computer Science, Statistics and Information Systems: advanced qualifications
requirements.details: For the named three programmes, applicants with A-level, certificate or diploma qualifications in Statistics, Mathematical Sciences or IT-related fields from higher-learning institutions are assessed by the relevant department for eligibility and entry point. This paragraph provides no automatic entry year, numerical A-level score or IB conversion.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 37–38: Computer Science, Statistics and Information Systems: advanced qualifications

requirements.label: Human Geography and Planning: department assessment
requirements.details: For Human Geography and Urban and Regional Planning, A-level/certificate/diploma qualifications in Geography or related fields from higher-learning institutions are submitted to the department to determine eligibility and entry point. Neither paragraph states a guaranteed advanced-entry year.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 39–40: Human Geography and Planning: department assessment

requirements.label: Three Commerce degrees: distinction diploma OR CAS accountant
requirements.details: For Accounting and Finance, Marketing and Human Resource Management, indirect entry normally accepts an IEMS Diploma in Business Management with distinction OR a CAS Licensed Accountant qualification with at least LGCSE D in Mathematics AND English. The CAS school grades are attached to that alternative; neither qualification is required in addition to the other.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 41–42: Three Commerce degrees: distinction diploma OR CAS accountant

requirements.label: Marketing and HRM: other qualifications require review
requirements.details: Marketing and Human Resource Management additionally list qualifications from other higher-learning institutions for departmental evaluation and consideration. The Accounting and Finance paragraph does not expressly print this additional alternative. No automatic qualification equivalence or entry year is promised.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 42: Marketing and HRM: other qualifications require review

requirements.label: Public Administration and Politics: LIPAM credit diploma

requirements.details: The three-year indirect Diploma in Adult Education ODL route gives LGCSE with minimum achievement D or COSC with passes in any three subjects including English, PLUS prior learning or relevant work experience in formal/non-formal education and community-development programmes. No fixed number of work years is stated.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 48: Adult Education diploma: prior learning/work pathway

requirements.label: Mass Communication diploma: prior study and communication proficiency
requirements.details: The indirect ODL Mass Communication diploma paragraph lists completed LGCSE and evidence of related short courses, certificates or diplomas in communication, journalism or media studies, together with communication proficiency and relevant work evidence. It does not publish a numerical language-test score, minimum work duration or an IB total.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 50: Mass Communication diploma: prior study and communication proficiency

requirements.label: Mass Communication diploma: supporting work evidence
requirements.details: For its indirect route, relevant work experience is supported by a recommendation letter, portfolio of work OR employment contracts. These support options are not three documents automatically required together, and no work-duration minimum is published in this paragraph.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 50: Mass Communication diploma: supporting work evidence

requirements.label: Mass Communication diploma: institutional RPL form
requirements.details: Applicants using the Mass Communication diploma's indirect/prior-learning route are expected to complete the institution's recognition-of-prior-learning form with supporting documents. This is route-specific; it is not an extra form expressly required for every direct school-leaver applicant.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 50: Mass Communication diploma: institutional RPL form

requirements.label: Management diploma: certificate OR school/prior-learning route
requirements.details: For the indirect ODL Diploma in Management, one alternative is an additional certificate from a CHE-recognized higher-learning institution passed at least at pass level. The OR alternative is LGCSE/equivalent D in English, Mathematics and a commercial subject (examples: Economics, Accounting, Commerce, Business Studies or Consumer Studies), PLUS prior learning or relevant work in formal/non-formal education/community development. The certificate alternative is not automatically burdened with the school/prior-learning conditions.

requirements.label: Management diploma: evidence and assessment
requirements.details: For the indirect Management diploma pathway, the source says supporting transcripts, CV and/or portfolio, references and an assessment test will be considered. It gives no test score, pass mark, fixed work duration or required commercial-subject list beyond the named examples. Preserve the and/or wording instead of requiring both CV and portfolio from everyone.
